title: Offline Recommendation Engine and Safe Executor for VPC Cost Automation
creator: Maya Singh
description: Build an offline recommendation engine plus a conservative 'Safe Executor' that produces batching and KV-caching configuration suggestions for Private/VPC/on-prem deployments and can apply them via a deterministic, auditable dry-run and a guarded apply with automated rollback. Key constraints: cannot call external telemetry endpoints from on-prem sandboxes, must respect customer KMS policies and RBAC, and operate without changing live routing or exposing secrets. The engine operates on captured traces and synthetic replay: it performs discrete parameter sweeps across batch size, max_tokens_per_request, request_concurrency, prefix caching TTLs, and safe quantization profiles. Each candidate config is scored with multi-dimensional safety heuristics (latency SLO risk, memory headroom, CPU/GPU utilization, correctness regressions estimated via prompt-level checks) and a cost delta estimate. The Safe Executor runs in two modes: dry-run (produces exact config diff plus synthetic traffic simulation) and guarded-apply (applies config to a staged target with traffic shadowing, realtime metrics checks, and circuit-breaker based rollback). The system emits a signed artifact for audit and supports an operator review gate. This ticket covers engine prototyping, policy-enforcement integration, and a V1 of the executor that is compatible with VPC/on-prem constraints.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Recommendation engine can run offline on a captured trace file and output a ranked list of config proposals with estimated cost delta and risk score. 2) Dry-run mode produces a deterministic 'diff' artifact and a simulated latency/cost report without touching production endpoints. 3) Guarded-apply will be able to deploy a candidate config into a staged VPC worker, shadow 10% of traffic, monitor p95 latency and error rate for 15 minutes, and automatically rollback on thresholds. 4) All operations run under customer VPC constraints: no outbound calls beyond allowed endpoints, KMS keys are referenced but not exported, and audit logs are produced. 5) Security review signed off and Confluence runbook drafted.
tasks: Define offline trace schema and capture tooling (compatible with existing request tracing)
Implement discrete-sweep simulation harness (batch size, concurrency, kv-ttl, quant-profile)
Design and implement safety scoring heuristics and risk thresholds
Build dry-run diff generator that is deterministic and signs artifacts
Integrate policy engine with allowlist/denylist and soft-fail modes
Prototype guarded-apply controller with shadowing and circuit-breaker
Add audit log format and operator review UI hooks for Console team
Write Confluence runbook and compliance notes for Private customers
End-to-end test on an isolated VPC deployment (synthetic load)

test_plan: Unit tests for simulator kernels (determinism, memory estimation). Replay tests using two captured real-world traces and two synthetic high-QPS traces. Regression checks: run a canonical prompt set and ensure top-k outputs match baseline model above configured tolerance. Canary/Shadow test: apply to a staged pool with 10% shadowing, monitor p95 latency, p50 token cost, and request error rate. Failure conditions trigger immediate rollback and produce postmortem artifact.
rollout_plan: Phase A (dry-run): Make recommendation engine available to internal staff with a CLI that consumes trace files. Phase B (staged apply): guarded-apply to a staging VPC with shadowing, allow operator review and manual apply. Phase C (pilot): enable automatic guarded-apply for 2 pilot customers behind an opt-in feature flag. Metrics to track during rollout: cost_delta_est, actual_cost_change, p95_latency, error_rate, rollback_count.
